s.note: Crisp crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre, a Little Havana bakery classic.
s.how: Melt 60g butter, cook 80g flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Stir in 200g finely chopped ham and nutmeg, chill 3 hours. Shape 20 logs, roll in egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C until golden.

s.note: the studio meetings Chili talks his way into
s.how: Blitz the mayonnaise, sour cream, a big handful each of parsley and tarragon, half the chives, the anchovies and the lemon juice until smooth and green. Trim the carrots and radishes, leaving a little green on top. Cut the cucumber into batons and pull the cos into leaves. Stand the vegetables up in glasses of ice and serve with the green goddess in a bowl.

m.note: he knows exactly how a scene should go
m.how: Fry 1kg potatoes cut into thin frites at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 185C until crisp. Season 4 sirloin steaks, about 800g, sear hard for 3 minutes a side and rest. Sweat 2 chopped shallots in the pan fat, add 150ml red wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in 50g cold butter. Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge, a handful of caramel popcorn (popcorn tossed in brown sugar and butter caramel, baked to set) and salted peanuts.
w.how: Pop 40g popcorn kernels. Melt 50g butter with 80g brown sugar, toss through the popcorn and bake at 150C for 10 minutes to set. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop 8 balls of vanilla ice cream into four bowls, pour over the fudge and top with the popcorn and 50g salted peanuts.

d.note: 45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper, rolled between tins, celery stick.
d.how: For each drink, put 45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, 10ml lemon juice, 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce, 2 dashes hot sauce and a pinch each of celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice. Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times, strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Makes four.
